notes: Wikiquote verbatim: 'Zoinks! These peppers are, like, hot!' (Shaggy), Mary Jane's '100% vegetarian', 'And...all you can eat.', the dining room of the Spooky Hotel, Scooby gulping the jar of peppers, the jug of water off the waitress's tray, the ketchup, Daphne snatching Velma's glasses, Old Man Smithers, tagline. Wikipedia: Luna Ghost, Zarkos, Mary Jane allergic to dogs, haunted house ride, Daemon Ritus, Mondavarious a robot run by Scrappy, Daphne's disco ball. Every dish and drink is alcohol-free. The tiki map labels (Main isle, Snack cay, Spooky Island, Sweet reef) sit on stills of Scooby, the gang and Shaggy as stock section names and read oddly, but claim nothing. No still repeats the poster.

vibe.verdict: Spooky Island with Scooby Snacks and the pepper contest is right, but it is still a generic tiki chart with odd 'see snack bar' heads and no Mystery Machine.
missing: Fred and Velma's 'Jinkies' and the gang splitting up
Shaggy and Scooby's body swap and the burping contest
The Luna Ghost and 'meddling kids' (the opening)
Scooby in disguise as an old lady
